ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring irregular peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels relative to the mean edge trajectory.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex curves originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward toward the distal tips with increasing curvature near the lateral margins.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration/trauma along the trailing edge and heavy circular scarring (rosettes) across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-texture clusters of barnacles visible at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
